messages:
morgan: Heads-up — found a couple small but blocking issues in the Dedicated Capacity docs while preparing the migration playbook. main ones: broken links in the autoscale policy section, SDK snippet uses old param names, and SLA table doesn't call out eviction/isolation differences clearly.

alex: thanks for catching. can you paste the broken links? i'll open a quick PR for the SDK snippet. :+1:

morgan: sure — from the migration guide page: /dedicated/autoscaling -> returns 404 (should be /dedicated/autoscale). also guides/dedicated-slas.md links to an internal Confluence that was archived.

docs-bot: Link-checker: found 2 broken links in sources/docs/dedicated/migration.md at lines 42 and 128.

liam: i can take the SLA wording and the eviction/isolation paragraph. current paragraph is vague about tenant isolation guarantees during preemption. we should add a short example: when reserved pools are evicted, customer traffic falls back to shared-tier with ~95th-percentile latency degrade and no guaranteed throughput.

alex: agreeing. i'll replace the SDK snippet. current snippet uses `reserved_instance_type` and we now accept `capacity_profile`. also update example to include `autoscale_policy` dict. quick sample i'll push: 

alex: ```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient(api_key=REDWOOD_KEY, capacity_profile="reserved-4x")
resp = client.generate(model="rw-large-v1", prompt="Summarize quarterly results")
print(resp.text)
```

sophia: small note on the sample: add a timeout and explicit region so users in EU don't get the NA defaults. e.g. `client = DedicatedClient(..., region="eu-west-1", timeout=30)`

morgan: good catch. liam, for the SLA table can you include a column for "isolation type" (isolated pool, shared fallback) and a short bullet list of mitigation (canary rollout, automatic fallback to compatible model variant)?

liam: yep. i'll add a new row to the table and a brief migration checklist:
- verify model compatibility for fallback variant
- set `autoscale_policy.max_burst` to non-zero if you rely on short bursts
- pin model version in deployment to avoid surprises

morgan: also request: please add a short note in the migration guide about the SDK param change with an inline diff and a link to the new SDK reference. that link is the one that needs to be fixed in the doc.

alex: PR opened: #2147 — changed snippet, added region+timeout, and swapped `reserved_instance_type` -> `capacity_profile`. tagging @liam for SLA updates. summary in PR description.

docs-bot: CI: docs build succeeded for branch feat/dedicated-docs-2147 (deploy preview URL: https://deploy-preview/redwood/docs/dedicated/feat-2147).

morgan: reviewed the PR, left 2 minor inline comments (naming and a small grammar tweak). after fixes, please squash merge and I'll handle the redirect for the archived Confluence link to the new internal doc.

alex: fixed the comments and pushed. requesting final review.

sophia: quick thought — we should add a tiny sample terraform snippet linking to Dedicated provisioning APIs. users keep asking for a one-liner snippet in docs. i'm happy to draft if no one else is.

morgan: that would be great, sophia. add it under "Provisioning quickstart" with a note about reserved commit and billing. keep it minimal.

liam: merged the SLA and eviction clarifications into the table and added an example traffic flow diagram (ASCII) for fallback.

morgan: excellent. after the merge i'll run a link-check job against the preview and then move the redirect. thanks everyone — should be good to close this thread once the redirect is in place. :shipit:

alex: thanks all. closing after redirect.

docs-bot: Action: created redirect rule from /guides/dedicated-slas -> /docs/dedicated/slas (expires in 30d).
